6107-the-truth-about-jesus-is-he-a-myth.title: The Truth About Jesus Is He A Myth
6107-the-truth-about-jesus-is-he-a-myth.creator: Unknown
6107-the-truth-about-jesus-is-he-a-myth.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. After sleeping in my grave for many centuries I awoke suddenly--I cannot tell how nor why--and was transported by a force beyond my control to this new day and this new city. I arrived here at daybreak, when the sky was still dull and drowsy.

arxiv-2102-07537.title: CHARET: Character-centered Approach to Emotion Tracking in Stories Conference: Proc. of the 20th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2021); May 3–7, 2021; Online
arxiv-2102-07537.creator: Diogo S. Carvalho, Joana Campos, Manuel Guimarães, Ana Antunes, João Dias, Pedro A. Santos
arxiv-2102-07537.description: Abstract . Autonomous agents that can engage in social interactions with a human is the ultimate goal of a myriad of applications. A key challenge in the design of these applications is to define the social behavior of the agent, which requires extensive content creation.

arxiv-2103-07792.title: Multilingual Code-Switching for Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Intent Prediction and Slot Filling
arxiv-2103-07792.creator: Jitin Krishnan, Antonios Anastasopoulos, Hemant Purohit, Huzefa Rangwala
arxiv-2103-07792.description: Abstract Predicting user intent and detecting the corresponding slots from text are two key problems in Natural Language Understanding (NLU). In the context of zero-shot learning, this task is typically approached by either using representations from pre-trained multilingual transformers such as mBERT, or by machine translating the source data into the known target language and then fine-tuning.

arxiv-2106-12229.title: Theoretical and Numerical Investigation of Nonlinear Thermoacoustic, Acoustic, and Detonation Waves Volume:
arxiv-2106-12229.creator: Prateek Gupta
arxiv-2106-12229.description: Abstract Finite amplitude perturbations in compressible media are ubiquitous in scientific and engineering applications such as gas-turbine engines, rocket propulsion systems, combustion instabilities, inhomogeneous solids, and traffic flow prediction models, to name a few. Small amplitude waves in compressible fluids propagate as sound and are very well described by linear theory.

arxiv-2112-10659.title: REFORM: Reputation Based Fair and Temporal Reward Framework for Crowdsourcing
arxiv-2112-10659.creator: Samhita Kanaparthy, Sankarshan Damle, Sujit Gujar
arxiv-2112-10659.description: Abstract Crowdsourcing is an effective method to collect data by employing distributed human population. Researchers introduce appropriate reward mechanisms to incentivize agents to report accurately. In particular, this paper focuses on Peer-Based Mechanisms (PBMs). We observe that with PBMs, crowdsourcing systems may not be fair, i.e., agents may not receive the deserved rewards despite investing efforts and reporting truthfully.

arxiv-2211-09763.title: On the growth of the Jacobians in ℤ p l \mathds{Z}_{p}^{l} -voltage covers of graphs
arxiv-2211-09763.creator: Sören Kleine, Katharina Müller
arxiv-2211-09763.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sören Kleine, Katharina Müller. We investigate the growth of the p p -part of the Jacobians in voltage covers of finite connected multigraphs, where the voltage group is isomorphic to ℤ p l \mathds{Z}_{p}^{l} for some l ≥ 2 {l\geq 2} , and we study analogues of a conjecture of Greenberg on the growth of class numbers in multiple ℤ p \mathds{Z}_{p} -extensions of number fields.

arxiv-2301-11409.title: Self-testing composite measurements and bound entangled state in a single quantum network
arxiv-2301-11409.creator: Shubhayan Sarkar, Chandan Datta, Saronath Halder, Remigiusz Augusiak
arxiv-2301-11409.description: Abstract Within the quantum networks scenario we introduce a single scheme allowing to certify three different types of composite projective measurements acting on a three-qubit Hilbert space: one constructed from genuinely entangled GHZ-like states, one constructed from fully product vectors that exhibit the phenomenon of nonlocality without entanglement (NLWE), and a hybrid measurement obtained from an unextendible product basis (UPB).

arxiv-2308-00020.title: Mapping out the parameter space for photoevaporation and core-powered mass-loss 2015 Mapping out the parameter space for photoevaporation and core-powered mass-loss – B
arxiv-2308-00020.creator: James E. Owen, Hilke E. Schlichting
arxiv-2308-00020.description: Abstract Understanding atmospheric escape in close-in exoplanets is critical to interpreting their evolution. We map out the parameter space over which photoevaporation and core-powered mass loss dominate atmospheric escape. Generally, the transition between the two regimes is determined by the location of the Bondi radius (i.e. the sonic point of core-powered outflow) relative to the penetration depth of XUV photons.

arxiv-2311-09551.title: Universal Hyperuniform Organization in Looped Leaf Vein Networks
arxiv-2311-09551.creator: Yuan Liu, Duyu Chen, Jianxiang Tian, Wenxiang Xu, Yang Jiao
arxiv-2311-09551.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yuan Liu, Duyu Chen, Jianxiang Tian, Wenxiang Xu, Yang Jiao. Leaf vein network is a hierarchical vascular system that transports water and nutrients to the leaf cells. The thick primary veins form a branched network, while the secondary veins can develop closed loops forming a well-defined cellular structure. Through extensive analysis of a variety of distinct leaf species, we discover that the apparently disordered cellular structures of the secondary vein networks exhibit a universal hyperuniform organization and possess a hidden order on large scales.

arxiv-2502-11202.title: Stochastic baryon charge transport in relativistic hydrodynamics
arxiv-2502-11202.creator: Nicolas Borghini, Baochi Fu, Sören Schlichting
arxiv-2502-11202.description: Abstract We utilize 3+1D stochastic hydrodynamics to study correlations and fluctuations of baryon charge in high-energy heavy-ion collisions. The baryon charge fluctuations are important observables to probe the QCD phase diagram, yet a dynamical description with stochastic hydrodynamics remains challenging due to numerical instabilities and high computational demands.

arxiv-2509-10592.title: The Modular Energy Function : the Sum of Remainders E m ​ ( n ) = ∑ k = 1 m ( n mod k ) E_{m}(n)=\sum_{k=1}^{m}(n\bmod k)
arxiv-2509-10592.creator: Es-said En-naoui
arxiv-2509-10592.description: Abstract We introduce and study the elementary arithmetic function E m ​ ( n ) = ∑ k = 1 m ( n mod k ) , E_{m}\!\left(n\right)\;=\;\sum_{k=1}^{m}(n\bmod k), which aggregates the remainders of a fixed integer n n modulo the first m m positive integers.

arxiv-2510-09659.title: Heterogeneous Point Set Transformers for Segmentation of Multiple View Particle Detectors
arxiv-2510-09659.creator: Edgar E. Robles, Dikshant Sagar, Alejandro Yankelevich, Jianming Bian, Pierre Baldi, For the NOvA Collaboration
arxiv-2510-09659.description: Abstract NOvA is a long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiment that detects neutrino particles from the NuMI beam at Fermilab. Before data from this experiment can be used in analyses, raw hits in the detector must be matched to their source particles, and the type of each particle must be identified.

pmc-11608785.title: Innovative 3D Navigation Module for Precise Unilateral Pedicle Screw Combined with Contralateral Translaminar Facet Screw Placement in Lumbar Spine Surgery

Unilateral pedicle screw combined with contralateral translaminar facet screw fixation offers the advantages of less trauma, better stability, and fewer complications. However, the surgical difficulty and suboptimal pinning accuracy of translaminar facet screw placement in clinical practice limit its use.

pmc-11709697.creator: Gabriela Raquel Paz Rivas, Victória Tizeli Souza, Simone Sieben da Mota, Bruno De Oliveira De Marchi, Guilherme Da Silva Carvalho, Haniel Bispo De Souza, Lucas Bastos Beltrami, Rhaná Carolina Santos, Sarah Vitoria Bristot Carnevalli, Ana Letícia Amorim de Albuquerque, Leonardo Martins de Paula, Manu
pmc-11709697.description: BackgroundSubjective cognitive decline (SCD) is defined by the presence of cognitive complaints in cognitively unimpaired (CU) individuals. Despite being part of the continuum of a neurodegenerative disease, the cause of the cognitive complaint is quite heterogeneous. Sleep disturbances may be associated with cognitive complaints and even objective cognitive decline.

pmc-12533352.title: Inpatient addiction care is associated with increased vaccinations, medication for opioid use disorder and naloxone prescribing among patients with infective endocarditis in a rural state
pmc-12533352.creator: Eva J Farkas, Victoria Molina, Brittany Mohoney, Wendy Craig, Jessie Schaumberg, Amy McAuliffe, Kinna Thakarar
pmc-12533352.description: BackgroundRural states have experienced increasing injection drug use (IDU)-associated infective endocarditis (IE). Inpatient addiction consult services can reduce morbidity associated with substance use and other infectious complications, such as IDU-IE. However data on the impact of such services on healthcare utilization are limited, particularly in rural communities.

To age positively, one must manage hidden or unrecognized challenges, show flexibility in behavior and thought, adopt a positive outlook on problems involving regression, and make decisions that promote one’s well-being.

pmc-13299756.title: Ventricular substrate characterization using high-density omnipolar mapping in patients with repaired tetralogy of fallot
pmc-13299756.creator: J Lopez Baizan, M Baz Gonzalez, M Frutos Lopez, J Acosta Martinez, J A Sanchez Brotons, A Pedrote, E Arana Rueda
pmc-13299756.description: BackgroundHigh-density electroanatomical mapping enables the characterization of the arrhythmic substrate in patients with repaired Tetralogy of Fallot (rTOF), facilitating the identification and ablation of slow-conducting anatomical isthmuses (SCAIs) responsible for ventricular tachycardia. It is unknown whether the use of omnipolar mapping (OM) technology provides a more accurate characterization of the arrhythmic substrate in this setting.

pmc-13472915.creator: Chuanzhao Chen, Yigang Zhang, Peng Liu
pmc-13472915.description: BackgroundChina’s long-term care insurance reform is a key component of multilevel medical security for addressing care needs among older adults with substantial functional decline, and it also raises an ethical governance question: how family-based Confucian care responsibilities are translated into modern rules of eligibility, payment, service provision and regulation.

pmc-13475558.title: Dose-dependent perinatal risks of clomiphene citrate in US IVF cycles: a national cohort study, 2004–2021
pmc-13475558.creator: Sheree Boulet, Yujia Zhang, Dmitry Kissin, Michael Davies
pmc-13475558.description: ObjectivesThe relationship between clomiphene citrate (CC) dosing regimens and adverse reproductive outcomes has not been fully elucidated, both with and without use of in vitro fertilisation (IVF). We aimed to study the association between cumulative CC dose and perinatal outcomes among fresh autologous IVF cycles.DesignRetrospective cohort study.

pmc-13548690.creator: Michelle Gooey, Heather Morris, Rebecca Madill, Callie Walsh-Bailey, Ahlia Griffiths, Melissa Savaglio, Claire Blewitt, Amanda O’Connor, Sara Holton, Helia Khalesi, Sofia Grage-Moore, Maria Fernandez, Echezona E. Ezeanolue, Allison Metz, Ana Baumann, Helen Skouteris
